[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
In order to place the portraits in your game you must manually replace them in the Ridgeside folder (which is really easy to do!)

Before you start adding it please download Seasonal Outfits for Ridgeside Village first!!! Unpack the zip file and Leave the folder from this mod on your deskop for now. (If you already know how to do it, go ahead but this is a very manual instruction so no one gets confused)
1. [img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50672/50672-1786633726-1718185592.png[/img]
2. [img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50672/50672-1786633807-1044469359.png[/img]
3. Assets>Portraits>Ian.  [b]Move The portraits from my folder to the Ian folder and press "replace"[/b]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50672/50672-1786634041-47127183.png[/img]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50672/50672-1786634158-1715895752.png[/img]
